summary: The change fixes source-generator/analyzer crashes when a [MessagePackObject] member has a closed generic value type (struct or record struct) defined in a referenced assembly. The root cause is that metadata-declared members have empty DeclaringSyntaxReferences, so unguarded [0] access threw IndexOutOfRangeException (surfaced as AD0001); the fix makes member-location access null-safe and routes analyzer diagnostics through ReportIfLocatedInCompilation, which drops diagnostics whose location is not in the compilation being analyzed. Three new metadata-reference tests pass on head, fail on base, the full suite passes with no regressions, and docs describe the behavior; overall the change addresses the issue and is well covered by tests.

requirement_verdicts.confidence_basis: Three new metadata-reference tests pass on head with zero analyzer/generator diagnostics and the expected resolver hint name is generated, while on base the same input threw IndexOutOfRangeException in the shared TypeCollector path (surfaced as AD0001), and the head generator run explicitly asserts no diagnostics at Warning or above.

On base the same three tests failed with AD0001 (analyzer threw IndexOutOfRangeException); on head they pass with zero diagnostics because member-location access is now null-safe and diagnostics are filtered before reporting.

evidence.quote: this.reportDiagnostic = reportAnalyzerDiagnostic is null ? null : diagnostic => ReportIfLocatedInCompilation(reportAnalyzerDiagnostic, diagnostic);

requirement_verdicts.confidence_basis: ReportIfLocatedInCompilation only forwards a diagnostic when its location is in source and its syntax tree is contained in the compilation being analyzed; GetPropertyIdentifierLocation returns null for metadata-declared properties, producing Location.None diagnostics that are dropped, so no member diagnostic from a referenced assembly is reported at an outside location.
Full suite on head: 170 passed, 0 failed, with no failures that also fail on base and no new failures, so existing analyzer diagnostics for in-compilation types are unchanged.
The three new tests fail on base source with the fix reverted (3/3 failed, AD0001 IndexOutOfRangeException) and pass on head, so the fix is covered by tests that fail without it.
